title: Shopify Retail Roundup (August 2026 - v11.12, 11.13 & 11.14)
summary: Stay informed on the latest Shopify POS updates designed to help your retail business grow. POS App Version 11.12, 11.13 & 11.14.
body_markdown:
Shopify is always evolving, with new features and updates rolling out regularly to help retailers stay ahead—but keeping up shouldn't be a chore. That's why this hub tracks every POS update and relevant Shopify changes in one place.


Every two weeks, Shopify releases an updated POS version and this post is refreshed to highlight what's new. If you have multiple retail locations, it's best practice to use an[MDM (Mobile Device Management)](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/getting-started/mobile-device-management/index) to manage app versions, and to test each new release on a few devices before rolling it out to all stores.


Scroll to see the August 2026 updates below, or click the[Retail Release Roundup](https://www.shopify.com/blog/retail-release-roundup) for the latest news and most recent updates!


**Updates in POS version 11.14**


- Check connectivity status from POS Home
- Scan and search with multiple barcodes
- See abandoned online carts in POS
- Apply scanned gift cards automatically


**Updates in POS version 11.13**


- Set up staff in bulk with CSV import
- Continue returns and exchanges from recent carts
- Migrate Liquid receipt customizations


**Updates in POS version 11.12**


- Exchange prompt on the return screen
- Duplicate payment methods grouped in the refund cart


## Updates in POS version 11.14 (August 31, 2026 release date)


### Check connectivity status from POS Home


**What changed:** Connectivity status has moved from the POS side navigation to POS Home. Staff can see it as a status icon and open a popover for more detail without digging through menus.


**Why it matters:** When internet or device connectivity is uncertain, staff need a quick answer before starting checkout. Putting the status on POS Home helps teams troubleshoot sooner and avoid surprises during a sale.


**Access:** Automatically available in POS v11.14. No action required; all staff will have access.


### Scan and search with multiple barcodes


**What changed:** Shopify POS can identify a product variant using any associated barcode. Staff can scan or search using the code they have on hand and still find the correct variant in POS.


**Why it matters:** This helps retailers that receive products labeled differently by supplier, channel, or packaging format. Staff spend less time on manual lookup and can find the right item faster.


**Access:** Automatically available in POS v11.14. Before staff can use them in POS, associate the barcodes with products in Shopify admin.


[Learn more about scanning products in Shopify POS](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/add-update-products#scan-a-barcode)


### See abandoned online carts in POS


**What changed:** Authorized staff can view items from an identified customer's abandoned online checkout in Shopify POS. This shows checkout items associated with the customer, not their browsing history.


**Why it matters:** Staff get more context when helping a known customer in store. They can discuss products the customer already considered online and help continue the purchase in person.


**Access:** Available in POS v11.14 and permission-gated. Enable **View abandoned checkouts** in Shopify admin under Settings > Roles > Permissions > Customers. The customer must be identified, have an email address, have an eligible abandoned checkout, and the POS session must have location context.


[Learn more about viewing abandoned online carts in POS](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/shopify-pos/order-management/adding-online-cart-items-to-pos-cart)


### Apply scanned gift cards automatically


**What changed:** Valid gift cards are now applied automatically when staff scan them at checkout. This works with the in-app camera and supported first-party hardware scanners. Manually entered gift cards still use the Redeem button.


**Why it matters:** This removes an extra checkout step and reduces the chance that staff miss the additional tap to redeem a scanned gift card.


**Access:** Automatically available in POS v11.14. No action required. Auto-apply works only for scanned gift cards and still depends on the gift card being valid and redeemable.


## Updates in POS version 11.13 (August 19, 2026 release date)


### Set up staff in bulk with CSV import


**What changed:** You can now create, suspend, and reactivate staff accounts in bulk by uploading a CSV file to Shopify admin. Create admin or POS staff accounts with assigned PINs, or suspend and reactivate existing users in a single upload.


**Why it matters:** This saves time when opening new locations, preparing for seasonal hiring, or cleaning up staff records across a growing team. Instead of making repetitive manual changes, you can update many staff entries at once and reduce setup errors.


**Access:** Available in Shopify admin under Settings > Users > Import. Download the sample CSV template to get started.


[Learn more about importing users in bulk](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/your-account/users/import-users)


### Continue returns and exchanges from recent carts


**What changed:** Recent carts now include return and exchange carts that have already been started. Any team member can pick up, continue, and close them from another device, with the list filtered by default to the signed-in staff member.


**Why it matters:** Staff can start a return or exchange with a customer on the floor, hand it off, and complete it at the register without rescanning items or restarting the transaction.


**Access:** Return and exchange carts in recent carts are available in POS v11.13 for POS Pro locations with returns and exchanges enabled. Staff also need the required cart-sharing permission.


[Learn more about cart sharing in Shopify POS](https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/cart-sharing-on-shopify-pos)


### Migrate Liquid receipt customizations


**What changed:** Shopify has unified printed retail receipts into a single template and moved common customization into the receipt visual editor in the POS channel in Shopify admin. If you use the receipt code editor, your Liquid template will continue to print, but you need to migrate to the visual editor before January 1, 2027.


**Why it matters:** You can manage common changes such as field order, staff-attribution labels, business identifiers, return policies, and custom header or footer content without maintaining a full Liquid template.


**Access:** Preview and customize the visual editor from the receipt code editor while your Liquid receipt keeps printing. When you're ready, activate the visual-editor receipt. Activation applies to your whole shop and can't be undone, so review the previews before confirming.


[Learn more about customizing printed receipts](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/shopify-pos/customize-pos/printed-receipts)


## Updates in POS version 11.12 (August 10, 2026 release date)


### Exchange prompt on the return screen


**What changed:** Staff now see a callout on the return item selection screen prompting staff to add exchange items. Adding an exchange at this point in the flow was already possible, but now the screen surfaces a prompt more clearly on the screen where they are already working.


**Access:** Automatically available in POS v11.12. No setup required.


### Duplicate payment methods grouped in the refund cart


**What changed:** When refunding an order that was paid with more than one payment method, duplicate payment methods are now grouped into a single line in the cart. Previously, an order paid with the same method more than once—two separate card taps, or a gift card applied twice—showed each as its own entry, making it harder for staff to see how much was actually on each method. Grouping duplicates gives staff one clear number per payment method, so they can confirm the refund is going where it should before completing it.


**Access:** Automatically available in POS v11.12. No setup required.
